description: This file defines a builder class for constructing immutable SearchQuery objects with fluent API, including sorting and limiting options, within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating immutable SearchQuery instances, supporting sorting and limiting options.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQuery
classes.description: An immutable implementation of SearchQuery that encapsulates filter, sort, and limit options.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with the specified search filter.

methods.name: sortAsc
methods.description: Adds an ascending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: sortDesc
methods.description: Adds a descending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: removeSortOptionFor
methods.description: Removes the sort option for the specified property path.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets a limit with offset and count for the search query.

methods.name: removeLimitation
methods.description: Removes any limit constraints from the search query.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable SearchQuery object based on the current builder state.
